content.user_title: Design a Data IP Protection Strategy
content.value_statement: Data teams often lack a clear protection path for datasets, algorithms, and processing results. This skill compares legal options and structures evidence-preservation plans.
actual_capabilities: Compares copyright, patent, trade secret, and data intellectual property registration paths.
Maps confidentiality controls to secrecy, commercial value, and protective-measure requirements.
Outlines copyright registration and patent discovery preparation for data-related outputs.
Designs evidence-preservation workflows using hashes, timestamps, blockchain services, or notarization.
Creates checklists for registration, infringement analysis, contract clauses, and evidence packages.
Identifies when regional rules or licensed legal professionals must be consulted.
limitations: Guidance focuses on the Chinese legal and policy context.
The skill does not replace advice from qualified lawyers, patent agents, or authorities.
It cannot submit registrations, verify legal ownership, or issue enforceable legal opinions.
Regional pilot rules and cited laws may change after the knowledge base date.

use_cases.title: Protect a New Data Product
use_cases.description: Compare protection paths for a dataset, processing workflow, and related reports before launch.

use_cases.title: Strengthen Trade Secret Controls
use_cases.description: Assess confidentiality measures and create an evidence checklist for sensitive datasets and models.

use_cases.title: Prepare Registration Materials
use_cases.description: Organize processing evidence, ownership records, and supporting materials for professional review.

prompt_templates.title: Classify My Data Result
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify this result as a dataset, algorithm, model, report, or visualization: [description]. Explain which facts need clarification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a basic inventory of the asset.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Protection Paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare copyright, patent, trade secret, and data IP registration for [asset]. Consider disclosure plans, originality, technical features, and jurisdiction.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose one or more suitable protection paths.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Evidence Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an evidence-preservation plan for [asset]. Cover hashes, timestamps, version changes, ownership records, access controls, retention, and independent verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build an auditable record of creation and control.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Integrated Protection Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased protection program for [portfolio]. Include asset inventory, path selection, controls, registrations, contracts, evidence, owners, dependencies, and review gates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate legal, technical, and operational protection across a portfolio.

output_examples.input: Should an internal customer-scoring model use patent or trade secret protection?
output: Primary path: assess trade secret protection because the model is not intended for disclosure.
Patent review: evaluate whether the model produces a concrete technical effect and meets novelty requirements.
Next evidence: access logs, confidentiality agreements, model versions, development records, and a professional patent search.

output_examples.input: Create a preservation plan for a dataset that changes monthly.
output: Create a baseline hash for the approved dataset and retain the original in controlled storage.
Record each monthly version, processing steps, responsible staff, timestamps, and ownership statements.
Use an independent timestamp or suitable preservation service, then test certificate verification and archive recovery.

output_examples.input: What should we prepare before a data IP registration consultation?
output_examples.output: Prepare the dataset description, lawful source records, processing methodology, investment evidence, sample data, ownership agreements, version history, and applicable regional rules.

best_practices: Document data sources, processing contributions, ownership, and authorization before selecting a protection path.
Use layered protection when different components require different legal and technical controls.
Validate current regional rules and obtain professional review before filing or enforcement.
anti_patterns: Do not assume a blockchain record proves ownership, legality, or factual accuracy.
Do not claim trade secret protection without documented and consistently enforced confidentiality measures.
Do not disclose potentially patentable details before reviewing novelty and filing strategy.

faq.question: Can raw data receive patent protection?
faq.answer: Raw data generally cannot. A technically implemented processing method, model, or system may warrant patent assessment.

faq.question: Does blockchain preservation prove ownership?
faq.answer: No. It can support existence and integrity at a time, but ownership and lawful origin need separate evidence.

faq.question: Can copyright protect a database?
faq.answer: It may protect an original selection or arrangement. It usually does not protect factual data by itself.

faq.question: When is trade secret protection suitable?
faq.answer: It suits valuable nonpublic information when the owner applies reasonable, documented confidentiality measures.

faq.question: Does the skill submit applications?
faq.answer: No. It prepares analysis and checklists for review by authorities, lawyers, or patent professionals.

faq.question: Which jurisdiction does the guidance cover?
faq.answer: The knowledge base focuses on China. Confirm current national and regional requirements before taking action.
